clips.title: KCC20 Is Final. Time to Stop Saying KCC20.
clips.hook: KCC1, KCC2, and KCC20 are now final, meaning they are ready for full adoption across the ecosystem.
clips.caption:
KCC1, KCC2 and KCC20 are final. Ready for full adoption across the ecosystem.

KCC20 is the token standard built on covenants: tokens etched straight into the L1, no third-party indexer in the middle.

We say Solana tokens. We say ETH tokens. Now we just say Kaspa tokens. $KAS 🚀

clips.title: Why This Could Be Your Last Chance to Own Assets
clips.hook: This could be your last chance to get in on all these assets.
clips.caption:
We might get an insane bull run, bigger than anything the world has ever experienced. Not just crypto. Everything.

After that, everything gets so cheap... but how does the average person invest in something that grows into the next SpaceX?

No assets, almost like some sort of futuristic feudalism. It could be the last chance.

clips.title: If Anthropic's Engineers Say AI Codes Better Than Them... What About You?
clips.hook: Claude Code completely replaces any software engineers.
clips.caption:
Some of the engineers at Anthropic are among the highest caliber on the planet. And even they say AI can now write code better than them.

Now engineers do nothing but review AI code, and there's so much of it a human can't keep up. So now there are agents reviewing and testing the code.

Entire jobs are getting wiped out this year. Radiology is one of them.

clips.title: Asteroid Mining Is Coming for Gold. Guess Who's Out of Luck.
clips.hook: We're not far off from spaceships going to asteroids and mining gold.
clips.caption:
We're not far off from spaceships going to asteroids and mining gold. In other words, plummet the value of gold.

China has been buying a whole bunch of gold. And it seems like the US is trying to shift the backing of the dollar from oil to stablecoins.

So if gold suddenly gets devalued dramatically... who's holding the bag?

clips.title: Longevity Escape Velocity in 5 Years... Then What Happens to Social Security?
clips.hook: Longevity escape velocity is probably going to be reached within the next five years.
clips.caption:
Longevity escape velocity, probably within the next 5 years. You age a year, you gain back more than a year.

If a 90 year old has the health of a 50 year old, social security completely collapses. Trump accounts, kids getting stocks... maybe the powers that be are already seeing it coming.

Interesting world, but scary.
